title: FP8 margin controller and stochastic calibration harness for E4M3/E5M2 on Hopper
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Enable a conservative, telemetry-driven FP8 activation path on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) that reduces false-positive activations by introducing a dynamic margin controller and stochastic probing calibration harness. The goal is to increase safe FP8 coverage across our model catalog while keeping production regressions under the 0.5% quality SLO.
background: Recent activations of E4M3/E5M2 FP8 profiles produced intermittent quality degradations under low-latency, small-batch production traffic. Existing deterministic calibration pipelines miss rare tail cases. We need an adaptive approach that: (1) probes state space with short stochastic workloads; (2) adjusts per-op safety margins; (3) gates activation via canary metrics aggregated in the Console.
proposed_solution: Build a Margin Controller service that consumes telemetry from shadow runs and golden prompt suites. The controller will compute per-layer and per-op margin coefficients, expose a candidate profile artifact, and recommend activation thresholds (drift, perplexity delta, token-error rate). Pair this with a Stochastic Calibration Harness that runs short randomized inputs across shards to surface edge-case quantization failures. Add a Drift Sentinel to Alerting so we can rollback automatically if quality regressions exceed the configured thresholds.
rollout_plan: 1) Implement Margin Controller + harness in feature branch. 2) Run extended shadow experiments on Dedicated testpool for 2 weeks. 3) Promote candidate to dark-launch across 5% of production requests with fallback to FP16 on failure. 4) Gate full activation by canary metrics and manual review. 5) Post-rollout 4-week monitoring with automated rollback enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Margin Controller computes stable per-op margins such that mean perplexity delta across golden suite < 0.25%
Stochastic harness finds at least 95% of previously observed FP8 regressions in retrospective validation
Dark-launch in production shows no more than 0.3% increase in user-visible regression rate for 7 consecutive days
Automatic rollback triggers on regression > 0.5% and is exercised in a test run
Instrumentation dashboards display per-profile pass/fail, margin coefficients, and canary health signals
test_plan: Unit tests for margin computation and clamp logic
Integration test: harness runs on Dedicated testpool with seeded RNG to reproduce edge-case truncation
Golden prompt sweep: 5k prompts across summarization, instruction-following, and code outputs
Chaos test: introduce packet loss and CPU load to validate stability under degraded infra
Canary smoke: 5% dark-launch with fallback to FP16; collect drift/perf metrics for 7 days
telemetry_queries: SLO query: fp8_activation.user_visible_regressions.count grouped by model, region
Latency/cost: fp8.token_latency.p50/p95 and cost_per_token by profile
Shadow coverage: fp8_harness.coverage_ratio_by_op over latest run
